title: Flooding: What to do
summary: Immediate actions for rising water and flooded areas. PLACEHOLDER — must be replaced with reviewer-approved, rights-cleared content before release (PRD section 8.3, section 10.3).
steps: Move away from rising water when it is safe to do so.
Follow official evacuation instructions applicable to your area.
If water enters your home, switch off the electricity at the main breaker if safe to reach.
Move to higher ground or the safest upper floor; avoid enclosed attics without a way out.
Return home only after authorities declare it safe for your area.
avoid: Do not drive or walk through floodwater — moving water can sweep you off your feet.
Do not touch electrical appliances or outlets while standing in water or with wet hands.
Do not return home before waters have fully receded and authorities say it is safe.
Do not drink or wash with floodwater — it may carry sewage and chemicals.
